name_reason: Trailing '_51a70' equals the symbol's own address (0x51a70) -> Ghidra address residue, must be stripped per naming rules. The 'dato_dat' stem is the real resource filename DATO.DAT (not a domain ID) and is kept. Clean form matches the un-suffixed sibling resource-filename strings in the same table (fdtxt_dat, fdother_dat, fdmus_dat, tai_dat) and is unambiguous (only one DATO.DAT string exists). Rename is recorded only; applied in Stage 2.
purpose: Read-only resource filename literal "DATO.DAT" passed as the first argument to fd2_load_dat_resource to open the portrait/character sprite archive DATO.DAT.
logic_summary: 9-byte NUL-terminated ASCII C string (bytes 44 41 54 4f 2e 44 41 54 00 = 'DATO.DAT\0'). The address decays to a char* and is handed to fd2_load_dat_resource, which loads a portrait sprite by id into the portrait sprite buffer. Reader sites (9 xref sites across 7 functions): fd2_display_dialog_scene (x4, dialog-VM load-enemy/ally-sprite opcodes), fd2_play_final_chapter_30_ending, fd2_run_equip_member_menu, fd2_run_status_screen_member_menu, fd2_render_status_screen_static_layout, fd2_load_chapter_portrait. Never written.
element_semantics: ASCII bytes of the DOS 8.3 resource filename 'DATO.DAT' followed by the NUL terminator; consumed wholesale as a char* path string, no per-element indexing semantics.
notes: Source comment block at strtab.c:117-129 is already precise, accurate, and ASCII-only; verified against Ghidra ground truth: read_memory bytes match 'DATO.DAT\0' (LEN=9), datatype=string, all 9 xrefs are DATA reads passed as the path arg to fd2_load_dat_resource (confirmed by decompiling fd2_load_chapter_portrait, which shows fd2_load_dat_resource(0x51a70 /*"DATO.DAT"*/, ...)). No game-side write-xref exists -> truly const. comment_verdict=keep (no Edit to strtab.c). Ghidra annotation lives in the PRE_COMMENT field with correct, src-consistent content; left untouched (ghidra_plate_action=none) -- content is accurate and consistent and matches the established per-string annotation pattern of this data region; a one-off PRE->PLATE field migration would diverge from siblings and is out of scope for a comment-only refine. Minor imprecision in existing annotations: '9 fd2_* callers' counts xref sites (9), not distinct functions (7, since fd2_display_dialog_scene appears x4); not corrected as it is not contradictory/misleading enough to warrant a plate edit.
